# CMS and Turn-key Platform Evaluation

Evaluate custom code, Wix Studio, WordPress.com, managed/self-hosted WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, and credible alternatives on the same rubric:

- commercial/custom-domain limits and total ownership cost;
- responsive design, accessibility, SEO, performance, structured data, and media workflow;
- editorial roles, preview, approvals, scheduling, localization, export, and version history;
- contact, CRM, scheduling, social, GitHub, portal, connector, AI, and payment paths;
- extension/plugin ecosystem quality, update/supply-chain risk, testing, environments, backup, restore, rollback, and support;
- APIs/webhooks, portability, export fidelity, migration effort, and lock-in.

Do not assume custom code is better. Disqualify any option that fails a hard security, privacy, accessibility, commercial, or export gate.
